title: Platelets form a plug on the way to a clot
summary: OpenStax says platelets are cell fragments that take part in stopping bleeding, first as a plug and then in a clot.
body: OpenStax says platelets are fragments of large cells called megakaryocytes in the bone marrow. They are essential for hemostasis, the process by which bleeding ceases. That process has three steps in the chapter: a vascular spasm, a platelet plug, and coagulation that builds a fibrin clot. This card is the platelet part of that process. It is not care for a cut.
